title: Ghassan Kanafani's birth chart
metaDescription: Ghassan Kanafani's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 19.4° Aries. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 19.4° Aries, in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 19.4° Aries. That falls in the second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by the Sun in the classical scheme — a fire sign read through a cardinal season.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 18.1° Aries, Venus was at 28.0° Pisces, Mars was at 5.5° Taurus. Read together: a mind that decides at speaking speed; taste tuned to mood and undertow; drive that grinds rather than flares.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Mars to Uranus is the closest call of the day, a conjunction within 1.0°. Two bodies in the same degree are not read as neighbours but as a merger: whatever one wants, the other is already funding. Behind it, the Sun conjunction Mercury at 1.2°, and Saturn opposition Neptune at 2.7° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The day-stable angles form no closed figure. Nothing funnels; each aspect is its own negotiation, which the tradition reads as a chart of separate treaties rather than one campaign.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Five planets here sit in a sign the classical scheme scores. The Sun in Aries at 19.4° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; the Moon in Scorpio at 16.4° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Pisces at 28.0° is in exaltation; Mars in Taurus at 5.5° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Sagittarius at 24.4° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements water 4, fire 3, earth 3; modalities mutable 4, cardinal 3, fixed 3. Water reads the room before the room speaks — atmosphere first, analysis later. No settled placement falls in air — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Neptune was retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Scorpio for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.0° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 16.4°.
